_note: Thomas, 2026-10-17: 'start lane 0a step 2: EU house-price indices via Eurostat's national metadata, checking first whether Reg 2016/792 mandates them.' It does: Article 1 covers the HPI and the OOH price index, Article 3(1) obliges Member States to provide the harmonised indices, and Article 2(12) defines those to include both. Source: the national HPI reference metadata, prc_hpi_inx_esmshpi_<cc>.htm, linked from Eurostat's prc_hpi_inx_esms page (29 countries; Greece has none) and authored by each NSI. First batch: the seven countries whose own national HPI page could be identified and read. The rest are listed in HANDOFF section 3, item 0a. Batch 2 (same day): PT, DE, IT, LV. Batch 3 (same day, Thomas's ruling on countries with several national indices): FI, FR, NO. Batch 4 (same day): CY, MT, SI. Skipped under the ruling: BG, HU, LT and RO (each metadata page says no national HPI news release in section 10.1) and LU (published only as a short-term indicator series, no release). SK deferred: portal urls are session-encoded. Slovakia added 2026-10-18 once a stable report url was found. Finnish leads worked 2026-10-18: Handbook and building cost index edges wired; the CPI edge has no document. French nodes wired 2026-10-18 from Insee's IPL methodological note.

reports.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470 of 17 July 2023 laying down the methodological and technical specifications in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/792 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the house price index and the owner-occupied housing price index, and amending Commission Regulation (EU) 2020/1148
reports.description: The act implementing Regulation (EU) 2016/792 for the house price index (HPI) and the owner-occupied housing price index: the methodological and technical specifications national HPIs are compiled to. It amends Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/1148. Named in the legal-acts section of most countries' national HPI reference metadata on Eurostat's site. Minted 2026-10-17 (housing lane 0a step 2); read from CELLAR, since EUR-Lex is WAF-blocked from this machine.

reports.title: House price index and OOH PI
reports.description: Statistics Austria's quarterly house price index (HPI), with the owner-occupied housing price index on the same page, published since 2015 for residential property bought by private households. Its national reference metadata names Regulation (EU) 2016/792 and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470 as its EU legal acts. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: House Price Index
reports.description: Statbel's quarterly house price index for new and existing residential property bought by households, calculated with a hedonic model from real-estate transaction data of the FPS Finances' General Administration of the Patrimonial Documentation. Statbel states it calculates the index according to European regulations. The page was read in the browser pane on 2026-10-17, because statbel.fgov.be serves curl a bot challenge. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Swiss residential property price index (IMPI)
reports.publisher: Bundesamt für Statistik (BFS) / Federal Statistical Office (FSO)
reports.description: The FSO's quarterly residential property price index for Switzerland, compiled under the Federal Statistics Act (Switzerland is not bound by the EU HPI regulations). Its national reference metadata names the Eurostat RPPI Handbook among the international standards its production adheres to. Title as given in that metadata's publications field. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Housing price index (HPI)
reports.description: INE's quarterly housing price index for new and second-hand dwellings, base 2025. Its national reference metadata names Regulation (EU) 2016/792 and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470 as its EU legal acts. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: House Price Indices
reports.publisher: Državni zavod za statistiku (DZS) / Croatian Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: The Croatian Bureau of Statistics' quarterly house price indices, issued as First Releases. Its national reference metadata names Regulation (EU) 2016/792 as the basic act and Regulation (EU) 2023/1470 as the methodological specification. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: House Price Index (HPI)
reports.description: CBS's quarterly house price index, a weighted aggregate of the price index for newly built dwellings (developer survey) and the price index for existing dwellings (Land Registry transactions), from 2015. The url is CBS's survey description page, not an edition page; it was read in the browser pane on 2026-10-17 because cbs.nl fails a TLS handshake from curl on this machine. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Price indices of residential premises
reports.description: Statistics Poland's quarterly price indices of residential premises (the Polish HPI), released each quarter; the url is the latest edition found on 2026-10-17 (second quarter of 2026). Its national reference metadata names Regulation (EU) 2016/792 and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470, and says the methodology takes the RPPI Handbook's recommendations into account. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: House Price Index
reports.description: Statistics Portugal's quarterly House Price Index (HPI) press release, with existing and new dwellings and the number and value of transactions; the url is the 2nd Quarter 2026 edition (22 September 2026), read in the browser pane on 2026-10-17 because smi.ine.pt answered 500. Its national reference metadata names Regulation (EU) 2016/792 and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Häuserpreisindex
reports.description: Destatis's quarterly house price index for residential property (statistic 61262), released as a press release on residential property prices; the url is the 2nd quarter 2026 release (no. 336, 24 September 2026). reports.title: House prices
reports.description: Istat's quarterly press release on the House Price Index (HPI), published provisional each quarter; the url is the Q2 2026 edition (17 September 2026), found in the browser pane on 2026-10-17. reports.title: House price index
reports.publisher: Centrālā statistikas pārvalde (CSP) / Central Statistical Bureau of Latvia
reports.description: The Central Statistical Bureau's quarterly house price index, with a press release since the data for the first quarter of 2022. The url is the bureau's own metadata page for the statistic, not an edition page. Its national reference metadata names Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Prices of dwellings in housing companies
reports.description: Statistics Finland's quarterly price statistics for old and new dwellings in housing companies (blocks of flats and terraced houses), from the Tax Administration's asset transfer tax data. Finland's HPI metadata names it as one of the two national releases the HPI is published through; no national total is published. Minted under Thomas's 2026-10-17 ruling: where a country publishes several national indices and no total, each one its HPI metadata names is a node. Its own documentation names no EU act or the RPPI Handbook, so it is unwired. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Real estate prices
reports.description: Statistics Finland's quarterly statistics on prices of existing detached houses and plots, from the National Land Survey's purchase price register; its price index for newly built single-family houses uses the building cost index of residential detached houses. Finland's HPI metadata names it as the other national HPI release. Minted under Thomas's 2026-10-17 ruling: where a country publishes several national indices and no total, each one its HPI metadata names is a node. Unwired: its own documentation names no EU act or the Handbook. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Price index for second-hand dwellings
reports.description: The Notaires-INSEE second-hand housing price indices: quarterly, constant-quality changes in the net selling prices of existing dwellings, from notaries' transaction data. France's HPI metadata names it as the national existing-dwellings index. The url is Insee's indicator metadata page, not an edition page. Minted under Thomas's 2026-10-17 ruling: where a country publishes several national indices and no total, each one its HPI metadata names is a node. Minted 2026-10-17.
title_aliases: Indices Notaires-Insee des prix des logements anciens

reports.title: Price index for dwellings
reports.description: Insee's housing price index, which its own description says is composed of the old (second-hand) and new housing price indices, published since early 2013 with history back to 2000. France's HPI metadata names the new-housing index, and Insee documents that index under this composite indicator. The url is Insee's indicator metadata page. Minted 2026-10-17. Open: this may be France's national total, which would put France outside the several-indices ruling. See HANDOFF section 3, item 0a.

reports.title: Price index for existing dwellings
reports.description: Statistics Norway's quarterly house price index for existing dwellings, published since the first quarter of 1992, about 13 days after the quarter. Norway's HPI metadata names it as one of its two national indices; the total HPI is compiled only at Eurostat. Minted under Thomas's 2026-10-17 ruling: where a country publishes several national indices and no total, each one its HPI metadata names is a node. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Price index for new dwellings
reports.description: Statistics Norway's quarterly price index for new dwellings, the other of Norway's two national HPI sub-indices. Minted under Thomas's 2026-10-17 ruling: where a country publishes several national indices and no total, each one its HPI metadata names is a node. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: House Price Index
reports.description: CYSTAT's quarterly House Price Index press release; the url is the 2nd quarter 2026 edition, found in the browser pane on 2026-10-17 through the Price Indices subtheme page (the StaticPage links in the HPI metadata do not lead to it). reports.title: Residential Property Price Index (RPPI)
reports.description: NSO Malta's quarterly Residential Property Price Index news release, a quality-adjusted index compiled with the rolling time dummy method since Q1/2023. Malta's HPI metadata names this release as the HPI's national news release. reports.title: Residential housing price indices
reports.publisher: Statistični urad Republike Slovenije (SURS) / Statistical Office of the Republic of Slovenia
reports.description: SURS's quarterly First Release on residential housing prices (the Slovenian HPI, with new and existing dwellings and house sales). The title is from SURS's own methodological explanation 'House price indices' (June 2026), which names the release it relates to. The url is the 23 September 2026 release, found in the browser pane on the Real Estate Prices page. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: House price indices
reports.publisher: Štatistický úrad Slovenskej republiky (ŠÚ SR) / Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic
reports.description: The Statistical Office of the SR's quarterly information report on residential property prices (Slovak title 'Indexy cien nehnuteľností na bývanie'), with indices for Slovakia and its eight regions, split into new and existing dwellings, from transactions registered in the Real Estate Cadastre. The url is the 2nd quarter 2026 report (published 31 August 2026) in its ID-only form: the portal's own links carry a session-encoded tail, and this form redirects to the report in a browser (checked in the browser pane on 2026-10-18; curl gets a 403). Its national HPI reference metadata names Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470. Minted 2026-10-18.

reports.title: Building cost index
reports.description: Statistics Finland's monthly index of building costs in professional new building, from the price development of basic inputs (materials, labour, services), collected by inquiry and from Statistics Finland's other data. Statistics Finland's Real estate prices statistics base their new single-family house prices on it. Minted 2026-10-18.

reports.title: Enquête sur la commercialisation des logements neufs (ECLN)
reports.publisher: Service des données et études statistiques (SDES), Ministère de la Transition écologique
reports.description: SDES's quarterly survey of developers on the marketing of new dwellings built for sale: units put on sale, reservations, cancellations, stock for sale and prices, for programmes of five dwellings or more. It was redesigned in 2006 and 2017. Insee computes its new-dwellings price index from its transaction data. The url is SDES's own survey page. Minted 2026-10-18.

_dropped.why: RESEARCHED 2026-10-18. Finland's HPI metadata says house price indices are 'part of national CPI', and a web-search summary quoted a stat.fi sentence that the dwelling price indices 'function as source data for the national Consumer Price Index'. That sentence was NOT found in any raw page read: the current English and Finnish ashi documentation (read with curl and in the rendered browser pane), the 2023-09-01 dated version (it redirects to the current one), the 2021 ashi quality description and release, and the discontinued owner-occupied housing indices pages (oahi). The CPI's own documentation (khi, SIMS 18.1) does not name it either. A lead: an archived ashi quality description may carry it, but an archived copy caps at B.

RESEARCHED 2026-10-18. No Insee document read names the Handbook or an EU HPI act for either index: the p1643 and p1644 indicator tabs (description, institutional mandate, methodology, dissemination, publications, comments, in English and French; several other tabs answered 500), the Notaires-Insee methodology note (May 2025) and the IPL note (September 2018). France's EU legal acts are named only in France's HPI metadata on Eurostat's site (prc_hpi_inx_esmshpi_fr), which documents the HPI France transmits. Under the 2026-10-17 ruling that does not wire a national component index.
